_comment: Architecture P0 step 2 (12.11.2026). One operator: pc_operator. Others stay mounted (nothing deleted) but are marked legacy and are never resolved on the pult operator path. Flip "legacy" to false (or set BCC_OPERATOR_LEGACY_VISIBLE=name1,name2) to roll back.

pc_operator.note: GET/PUT /api/operator, agent role pc-operator; the only operator the pult resolves

pc_agent.note: Argon PC-Agent, own tables and policy; Argon WIP, do not touch

agent_opencode.note: NOT an operator any more: /api/agent/sessions/* is only the message transport the /m/op/ UI posts to, with agent_id = the pc_operator agent
